content.title: About
content.content: Canned peach in a juice pack (item 4013) consists of whole pieces of ripe peach that are hot‑processed and sealed in a hermetic pouch with their own juice. The product retains the natural aroma, sweetness, and nutritional qualities of fresh fruit.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peaches belong to the Rosaceae family and are close relatives of plums, apricots, and cherries.
Canning in the fruit’s own juice preserves up to 80 % of vitamin C compared with other processing methods.
Peaches are rich in beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
The juice pack made of PET provides a long shelf life without added preservatives.
In many countries canned peaches are traditionally used in desserts such as compote and fruit punches.

items.title: Rich in vitamins A and C
items.content: Vitamin A supports vision and immunity, while vitamin C acts as an antioxidant protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion, promotes satiety, and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium helps maintain fluid balance and normal heart function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Canned peaches contain virtually no fat, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and carotenoids in peaches help combat free radicals.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Many canned peach products contain added sugar, which may be unsuitable for people with diabetes or low‑carb diets.

items.title: Peach allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peaches, ranging from skin rashes to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Bisphenol A (BPA)
items.content: If the packaging material contains BPA, it could pose a health risk; choose BPA‑free packs when possible.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some manufacturers add preservatives such as potassium sorbate to extend shelf life.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Peaches from the pack can be eaten as a snack, added to oatmeal, yogurt, salads, baked goods, or used in sauces and desserts. Open the pouch and, if desired, drain excess juice before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened pouch in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days. Discard if the product develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
